newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market quiet, no sales - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market quiet, no sales - USDA.

text.p: Steers and heifers were not tested on a dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights), USDA said.
Dressed Basis Steers - No confirmed sales.
Dressed Basis Heifers - No confirmed sales.
Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested. Buyer inquiry fair. Seller interest light at weaker bids, as most producers have higher ideas.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink.
Confirmed - None Last Week - None Last Year - 200
Wk To Date - 500 Sm Pd Lst Wk - 100 Sm Pd Lst Yr - 1,700
